title: Publish-time system-font embedding via Local Font Access API (browser, no Rust/Tauri) — real Arial/bold/italic
description:
SHIPPED — publish-time system-font embedding via the browser Local Font Access API, with a weight/style-aware bundled fallback. Closes the "bold Arial renders regular in the SWF" gap.

ARCHITECTURE
- GlyphSource abstraction (font-extract.ts): { em, ascent, descent, path(code)->packed M/L/Q array, advance(code), isFallback }. fonts.ts encodeDefineFont2 now takes an optional GlyphSource (defaults to bundled fallback selected by bold/italic); its glyph-shape loop, ascent/descent and advance table all read from the source.
- LIVE path (font-extract.ts): resolveSystemGlyphSource / resolveFontGlyphSources query window.queryLocalFonts() ONCE, pick the best-matching FontData by family+weight+style (pickLocalFace scorer), fd.blob()->arrayBuffer->opentype.parse, extract outlines for the used code points (getPath(0,0,1024) scales any EM into the encoder's 1024 EM; cubic->quad de Casteljau split for real Arial cubics), build a GlyphSource. Cached/deduped per fontKey(family,bold,italic).
- INTEGRATION: compileDocument STAYS SYNC. New CompileOptions.fontGlyphSources (Map<fontKey,GlyphSource>). New exported collectFontFaceRequests(doc) derives (family,bold,italic,codePoints) per face, mirroring the existing embed-subset union. usePublish.publishToBytes() runs the async resolveFontGlyphSources pre-pass (like bitmap-pixel pre-decode) on Publish/Test Movie (the user gesture), passes the map in, and degrades silently to the bundled fallback on any failure.
- opentype.js moved devDependency -> dependency (browser-safe). Added local opentype.d.ts shim (no @types). CommonJS interop: default-import + .parse (named ESM import breaks raw Node ESM used by golden-parity.mjs).

FALLBACK (weight/style-aware) — the half that makes golden's bold title render bold even with NO system access:
- Bundled NotoSans-Bold/Italic/BoldItalic (SIL OFL, assets/*.ttf + OFL.txt). gen-glyphdata.mjs now emits FOUR variant tables; glyphdata.ts exports glyphPath(code,variant)/glyphAdvance(code,variant)/glyphVariantFor(bold,italic). bundledGlyphSource(bold,italic) selects the variant. Statics are EM=1000; normalized to the regular's 1024 EM via getPath size arg + advance*1024/1000. REGULAR table regenerated byte-identical to the old single-variant data (verified) so golden-parity is unaffected.

LIVE-PATH MANUAL VERIFY (Chrome only; headless cannot grant the permission):
1. pnpm dev:browser ; open http://localhost:1420 in Chrome (>=103).
2. Place bold Arial static text (or open golden.fla). Publish / Test Movie -> Chrome shows the "View fonts installed on this device" permission prompt; Allow.
3. The published SWF's DefineFont2 'Arial' now carries the real installed Arial-Bold outlines. Open in Ruffle (or the in-app player): the title is visibly bold with true Arial letterforms (not Noto). Deny the prompt or use Firefox/Safari -> falls back to bundled NotoSans-Bold (still bold).

EVIDENCE
- Unit: packages/swf/src/__tests__/font-extract.test.ts (17 tests) — mocks queryLocalFonts injecting NotoSans.ttf as the system font and asserts the GlyphSource/DefineFont2 are built from the injected outlines; direct cubic->quad split test (pathToPacked); fallback selects bold/italic/boldItalic; live path matches the bundled regular for the same source font; resolveFontGlyphSources falls back on missing API and on permission-denied (reject). pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run => 108 files / 1346 pass. pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run => 320 files / 5132 pass. authoring-ui => 37 files / 684 pass.
- golden-parity: node tools/golden-parity.mjs => EXIT 0 (SEMANTIC PARITY); node tools/golden-parity.mjs fixtures/golden/golden-v2.{fla,swf} => EXIT 0.
- Structural swf-dump: compiling golden (bundled-fallback path, as in node/headless) yields DefineFont2 name="Arial" with bold outlines — glyph 'T' (code 84) advance = 11860 = bold (593 EM * 20) vs regular 11380; bundled bold 'A' outline + advance (707) differ from regular (654). Proves golden's bold-Arial title embeds BOLD glyphs (previously regular Noto for every face).

NOTE: golden-fla-oracle Ruffle e2e was not run to completion in this session — the already-running dev server on :1420 did not mount a canvas (pre-existing env issue, unrelated to the publish-pipeline change; the live font path is documented as non-exercisable headless). Acceptance rests on unit tests + golden-parity + structural swf-dump per the task's own acceptance note.

Files: packages/swf/src/font-extract.ts (new), opentype.d.ts (new), fonts.ts, compile.ts, index.ts, glyphdata.ts (regen), scripts/gen-glyphdata.mjs, package.json, assets/NotoSans-{Bold,Italic,BoldItalic}.ttf + OFL.txt, src/__tests__/font-extract.test.ts (new); packages/authoring-ui/src/hooks/usePublish.ts; pnpm-lock.yaml; CLAUDE.md.
